props.name: loading
props.description: Blocks clicks while an action runs. `true` shows a spinner before the label (in place of `leading`); `"spin-icon"` spins the `leading` icon.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content after the label (and after `count`), usually an icon.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches to the full width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown inline after the label as a notification badge.

props.name: accept
props.description: File types to offer, as in `<input accept>`: ".pdf", "image/*", ...

props.name: capture
props.description: Opens the camera on phones: "user" or "environment".

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name for the hidden file input.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Files larger than this many bytes go to `onReject` instead.
